title: CRAC Analysis in Budding Yeast with HTP Tagged Proteins
author: Rosey Bayne
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5ppg5mn
materials: Using the QIAquick Gel Purification KIt (Qiagen) or Zymo Gel Clean and Concentrate Kit with mini elute columns , follow the provided gel extraction protocol by melting the gel at 42 °C , washing in Buffer QG (without isopropanol) and letting the column stand in an additional PE Buffer wash step for 00:10:00 (inverting the column: ensures all GHCl is removed). Elute with 20µl nuclease-free water: put water on membrane and let stand for 2-3 mins before spinning out. This is your sample for high throughput sequencing. We measure the DNA concentration using the QuBit with the dsDNA HS Assay Kit.

The concentration of the CRAC Library generated above is checked on the Qubit Fluorometer (ThermoFisher Scientific), using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit (ThermoFisher Scientific) and manufacturer's protocol. Bring all solutions to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare SMM-TRP Media
steps.instruction: Prepare Synthetic Minimal Medium - Tryptophan (SMM-TRP) to avoid UV interference from Tryptophan.

substeps.instruction: Autoclave 2 L milliQ water per CRAC sample in 5 L flasks.
Prepare 286 mL each of sterile 10x Yeast Nitrogen Base without Amino Acids (YNB-aas), 10x Complete Synthetic Medium - Tryptophan (CSM-TRP), and 20% glucose.
Pre-warm all components to 30 °C overnight.

steps.title: Culture Yeast Cells
steps.instruction: Grow HTP-tagged yeast strains to the required density.

substeps.instruction: Mix pre-warmed SMM media components with water in flasks.
Inoculate with yeast from starter culture to a starting density of ~0.070 x10^7 cells/ml (OD600 ~0.05). For multiple cultures, stagger starting OD600 at ~0.035 (2nd) and ~0.025 (3rd).
Shake at 30 °C until OD600 reaches ~0.5 (approx. 8 hours). Expected yield is ~1g cells/L.

steps.title: Heat Shock and UV Cross-linking
steps.instruction: Perform UV cross-linking, with optional heat shock for specific samples.

substeps.instruction: Pre-chill 50ml PBS tubes on ice (1 tube per culture plus 2 empty tubes per culture).

For heat shock: Collect cells onto 0.45µm or 0.8µm MF-membrane filters via vacuum filtration; transfer filter and cells into 2.858ml of SMM-TRP pre-warmed to 42 °C; incubate for exactly 16 minutes at 42 °C.
For control: Proceed immediately to cross-linking.
Perform UV cross-linking using the Megatron (UVO3): Wash tube with de-ionised water, set lamps, and irradiate culture for 100s while tipping to mix.
Collect irradiated culture, filter cells onto 0.45µm or 0.8µm MF-membrane filters, and transfer to pre-chilled PBS on ice.
Spin cells at 3000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, remove supernatant, and freeze pellets on dry ice before storing at -80 °C.

steps.title: Cell Lysis and Crude Extract Preparation
steps.instruction: Lyse cells and prepare the crude extract for purification.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5V of Zirconia beads (0.5mm, ~2.5 ml) to each tube.
Thaw pellets by vortexing for 1 minute, then 1 minute on ice; repeat this bead-bashing cycle 5 more times.
Add 1V (~1.0 ml/pellet) of TN150plus (50mM Tris.HCl pH7.8, 150mM NaCl, 0.1% NP-40, 5 mM 2-ME, and Roche EDTA-free protease inhibitor tablet) to each pellet.
Add another 3V TN150plus (~3 ml), shake vigorously, and centrifuge for 20 minutes at 4600 g at 4 °C.
Transfer supernatant (~4.5 ml) to 3x 1.5 ml safe-lock tubes and spin at 20,000 g for 20 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: IgG Sepharose Affinity Purification
steps.instruction: Purify HTP-tagged proteins using IgG Sepharose beads.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 125 µl of IgG Sepharose beads (approx 167 µl slurry) to a 15 ml falcon tube; wash 2x with 5 ml TN150plus.
Divide beads into falcon tubes, remove buffer, and resuspend in an equal volume of TN150plus.
Take a 5 µl aliquot of crude extract for western blotting and store at -80 °C.
Mix the remaining crude lysate with IgG Sepharose beads and nutate for 2 hours (avoiding the top lipid layer).
Spin beads at 1000 g at 4 °C and remove most of the supernatant.

steps.title: Bead Washing and TEV Cleavage
steps.instruction: Wash the beads and cleave the protein from the beads using TEV protease.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads 2x with 10 ml TN1000plus, then 2x with 10 ml TN150 (+ 2-ME, no protease inhibitors), agitating in the cold room for 5 minutes per wash.
Resuspend beads in a small volume of TN150 (+ 2-ME, no protease inhibitors), transfer to an eppendorf tube, and remove remaining buffer.
Add 600 µl of TN150 (+ 2-ME, no protease inhibitors) to resuspend beads.
Add 7 µl of HALO-TEV protease (5u/µl) and mix by inverting.
Incubate for 2 hours at 18 °C on a rotating wheel.
Spin mixture at 1000 g, transfer to a SnapCap column, and force eluate through to pool ~600 µl of eluate. Do not put on ice.

steps.title: Partial RNase Digestion
steps.instruction: Partially digest the RNA using RNace-IT.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a tube with 0.4 g Guanidine-HCl.
Take 25 µl of TEV eluate for western blot (store at -80 °C) and put 550 µl of eluate in a new tube.
Preincubate eluates at 37 °C, add 1 µl of diluted RNace-IT, and incubate for exactly 4 minutes at 37 °C (stagger samples by 30s).
Immediately add 500 µl of the mixture to the 0.4 g Guanidine-HCl tube and invert.
Vortex to dissolve Guanidine-HCl (final volume ~700 µl).

steps.title: Nickel Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Purify the RNP complexes using Nickel beads.

substeps.instruction: Place samples on ice; add 27 µl 5 M NaCl and 3 µl 2.5 M Imidazole (pH 8.0).
Add mixture to 50 µl of Nickel beads (pre-equilibrated 2x in Wash Buffer I and spun at 1000 g).
Transfer beads/buffer to a SnapCap column on ice.
Wash beads 3x with 400 µl cold Wash Buffer I by gravity flow.

steps.title: RNA 3' Linker Ligation
steps.instruction: Phosphatase treatment and ligation of the 3' linker.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads 3x with 600 µl cold 1x PNK buffer + 2-ME.
Spin out buffer at 1000 x g for 10 seconds, plug the column, and add 80 µl mix (16 µl 5x PNK Buffer, 54µl MQ water, 2µl RNasin, 8µl TSAP).
Incubate for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Wash beads once with 400 µl Wash Buffer I and three times with 400 µl 1x PNK buffer on ice.
Spin out buffer and add 80 µl Master Mix (16 µl 5x PNK Buffer, 50µl MQ water, 2µl RNasin, 8µl 3' linker (10µM), 2µl T4 RNA Ligase I, 2µl T4 RNA Ligase II K227A).
Incubate for at least 5 hours at 25 °C.

steps.title: RNA 5' Labeling and Linker Ligation
steps.instruction: Phosphorylate the 5' end and ligate the 5' linker.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads once with 400 µl Wash Buffer I and 3x with 400 µl 1x PNK buffer.
Spin out buffer, plug column, and add 16µl 5x PNK Buffer, 56µl MQ water, 4µl T4 PNK (5U/µl), and 4µl 32P-γATP (10µCi/µl).
Incubate for 40 minutes at 37 °C, then add 1 µl 100 mM ATP and incubate for another 20 minutes.
Wash beads 3x with 400 µl Wash Buffer I and 3-4x with 1x PNK buffer at room temperature until < 20-50 cps in flow through.
Spin out buffer and add 80 µl mix (16µl 5x PNK Buffer, 55.2µl MQ water, 0.8µl 100mM ATP, 2µl 100µM 5'-linker, 2µl RNasin, 4µl T4 RNA ligase).
Incubate at 16 °C overnight.

steps.title: RNP Complex Elution and Analysis
steps.instruction: Elute the RNP complexes and analyze via NuPAGE.

substeps.instruction: Wash beads 3x with 400 µl Wash Buffer II.
Spin out void volume and elute RNP complexes twice with Wash Buffer II plus (62.5 µl for -/+ heatshock or 125µl for controls) for 10 minutes; pool eluates.
Add 40µg (2µL) Glycoblue and 1.25 mL acetone; leave at -20 °C for at least 2 hours.
Spin at 16000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, remove liquid, spin again to remove acetone, and resuspend in 25µl 1x NuPAGE Sample Buffer (6% 2-ME).
Heat samples at 65 °C for 10 minutes and spin briefly.
Load radioactive samples in alternate wells of a 1.5 mm thick 10 well NuPage 4-12% gradient gel in 1x NuPAGE MOPS buffer; run at 150V for 1-1.5 hours.

steps.title: Protein Transfer and Western Blot
steps.instruction: Transfer proteins to membrane and perform Western analysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer proteins to Hybond-C Extra nitrocellulose membrane using wet transfer system and NuPAGE Transfer Buffer (15% MeOH) for 1.5 hours at 100V.
For Western analysis: Block for 1 hour in 5% skimmed milk in TBS-T, probe overnight at 4 °C with 1:5000 rabbit anti-TAP antibody.
Wash 3x in TBS-T for 10 minutes each, then probe for 1 hour at RT with 1:10,000 IRDye680 conjugated Donkey anti-rabbit secondary antibody in TBS-T.
Wash 3x for 5 minutes in TBS-T and image on Licor Odyssey.

steps.title: RNA Recovery and RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Recover RNA from the membrane and perform RT-PCR for library preparation.

substeps.instruction: Develop radioactive blot, cut out bands corresponding to protein + RNA, and slice membrane into bits.
Incubate membrane slices with 400 µl Wash Buffer II (1% SDS, 5 mM EDTA) and 100 µg Proteinase K; shake at 500 rpm, 55 °C for 2 hours.
Transfer supernatant to a new tube, add 50 µl 3M NaOAc (pH 5.2) and 500 µl Phenol:Chloroform:Isoamyl Alcohol (25:24:1); vortex and spin at 12000 x g for 20 minutes; collect top layer.
Precipitate RNA with 1 ml absolute Ethanol and 2µl Glyco-blue at -80 °C for 30 minutes; spin at 16000 x g for 20 minutes at 4 °C.
Wash pellet with 70% EtOH, spin at 16000 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C, and air-dry.
Resuspend RNA in 13µl mix (11µl MQ water, 1µl 10µM miRCat RT oligo, 1µl 10mM dNTPs); heat at 80 °C for 3 minutes, then snap-chill on ice for 5 minutes.
Add 6 µl mix (4µl 5x First Strand Buffer, 1µl 100mM DTT, 1µl RNasin); incubate at 50 °C for 3 minutes, add 1 µl Superscript IV, and incubate for 1 hour at 50 °C.
Inactivate Superscript IV at 65 °C for 15 minutes, then add 2 µl RNase H and incubate for 30 minutes at 37 °C.
Perform PCR using 4 µl of RT reaction in 50µl reactions with LA Taq Polymerase and specific primers (P5 Forward and PE mircat Reverse).
PCR Program: 95 °C (2 min); [98 °C (20s), 52 °C (20s), 68 °C (20s)] x 20-25 cycles; 72 °C (5 min).

steps.title: Library Purification and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Purify PCR products and verify library size via agarose gel.

substeps.instruction: Precipitate PCR products with 2.5V EtOH, 0.1V 3.0 M NaOAc, and 20 µg Glycoblue at -80 °C for 30 minutes; spin at 16000 x g for 20 minutes at 4 °C, wash with 70% EtOH, and resuspend in 15 µl nuclease-free water.
Prepare 3% Metaphore agarose gel in 1x TBE with SYBR Safe.
Add 6x Purple Loading Dye to samples and run gel at 80V until bromphenol blue reaches the bottom.
Scan gel and cut out the region above primer dimers up to ~180bp.

steps.title: Sequencing Preparation and MiniSeq Run
steps.instruction: Quantify and prepare the library for Illumina MiniSeq sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Quantify library using Qubit dsDNA HS assay; calculate stock concentration.
Dilute library to 1ng/µL (10nM).
Thaw Reagent Cartridge (30 min), Hybridisation Buffer, and Flow Cell (30 min).
Pool 1nM libraries (1µL each) in RSB Buffer; denature 5µL pool with 5µL 0.1N NaOH for 5 minutes; neutralize with 5µL 200mM Tris.HCl (pH 7.0).
Dilute denatured library with Hybridisation Buffer to 5pM (1ml total), then further dilute a 135µL aliquot to 1.8pM (500µL total).
Load 1.8pM library into well 16 of the Reagent Cartridge.
Set MiniSeq parameters: Recipe 'TruSeqSmallRNA', length '75', Single End Reads.
